faq.title: Questions people ask first
faq.text: Most people have never used escrow before. That's normal.

items.q: What is escrow, in plain language?
items.a: Escrow is a neutral holding place for money. The buyer pays Bizik instead of paying the seller directly. We hold the funds - visible to both of you, spendable by neither - until the goods arrive or the work is delivered and approved. Then the money goes to the seller.

Deal funds sit in segregated accounts, separate from Bizik's own money, held with licensed partners. We cannot spend them, and neither party can withdraw them unilaterally. Every movement needs your confirmation and your PIN.
Straight to MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money, or a bank account, in the currency you choose. Most payouts land within minutes; larger amounts get a manual review first, which usually takes a few hours.

A single escrow fee per deal, paid by the buyer and shown before anyone commits. The seller pays no fee on the deal, and there is no monthly charge or account fee. Use the calculator on this page for an exact figure.

items.q: What if the seller doesn't deliver?
items.a: Open a dispute before the approval window closes. Both sides upload evidence - photos, delivery notes, chat logs - and a Bizik mediator decides on that evidence. The outcome is release, refund, or a split.
Cameroon and the wider CEMAC region first, in XAF. Your Bizik wallet can also hold USD, EUR, GBP, NGN and GHS with live conversion, shown before you confirm.

meta.description: Create a deal, fund it with MTN MoMo or Orange Money, deliver, inspect and release. How a Bizik escrow deal protects buyers and sellers in Cameroon, step by step.

howItWorks.title: How Bizik keeps your money safe
howItWorks.text: Follow the money from the buyer's wallet to the seller's payout. At every stage you can see exactly where it is and who controls it.

steps.title: Agree the deal
steps.text: Either side creates the deal: what's being sold or built, the price, the currency, the delivery date, and milestones if it's a big one. You invite the other party by phone number - they don't need an account yet.
steps.label: Protected:
steps.note: nothing is charged until both sides accept the terms in writing.

steps.title: Pay into escrow
steps.text: The buyer funds the deal from MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money or their Bizik wallet. Confirmation is usually instant - both sides get a notification the second it lands.
steps.label: Protected:
steps.note: funds move into a segregated escrow account, not to the seller and not into Bizik's operating money.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: The seller ships the goods or submits the work, with proof attached - photos, tracking, files. The buyer gets an inspection window to check it and either approve or ask for a revision.
steps.label: Protected:
steps.note: the delivery, the proof and every message are timestamped - they become the evidence if there's ever a dispute.

steps.title: Release
steps.text: The buyer approves and the money moves. The seller receives the full deal amount in their Bizik wallet, withdraws to MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money, and both sides get a PDF receipt.
steps.label: Auto-release:
steps.note: if the buyer goes quiet after delivery, the funds release automatically once the inspection window closes - so sellers are never stuck.

disputes.title: What if something goes wrong?
disputes.text: Then the money stops moving. Either side can open a dispute at any point before release - you're never left alone with it.

items.title: Freeze
items.text: Funds lock instantly. No release, no refund, no payout while the case is open.

items.title: Evidence
items.text: Both sides upload proof: photos, delivery notes, files, chat history. 72 hours each.

items.title: Mediator
items.text: A neutral Bizik mediator reviews the file. We never take a side or a cut of the outcome.

items.title: Binding ruling
items.text: Release, refund, or split. The decision is final and executed the same day.

faq.q: How long can money sit in escrow?
faq.a: As long as the deal terms allow. Most deals set a delivery date and an inspection window of 3-7 days. If neither side acts, the funds auto-release to the seller once the window closes, or return to the buyer if nothing was ever delivered.

faq.q: Who pays the escrow fee?
faq.a: The buyer. The escrow fee is added on top of the deal amount when the deal is funded, and both parties see it before anyone commits. The seller receives the full deal amount, with no Bizik fee deducted.

faq.q: Can I release only part of the money?
faq.a: Yes. Deals with milestones release stage by stage, so a designer can be paid for discovery while the build is still in escrow. You can also agree a partial release on a single-stage deal.

faq.q: What happens if the buyer just disappears after delivery?
faq.a: Auto-release protects the seller. Once the inspection window closes without an approval or a dispute, the funds are released automatically and paid out on the seller's normal payout schedule.

pricing.tableNote: Your mobile-money operator may charge its own fees for paying in or cashing out; those are theirs, not ours. Withdrawals of 500,000 XAF or more to mobile money are checked by a person before they are paid out, at no extra charge.

planDirect.title: Sending directly
planDirect.text: Free - and completely unprotected. If the deal fails you have a screenshot and a phone number.

planBizik.title: Bizik
planBizik.text: Mobile-money native, phone-first, FCFA. Mediation, KYC and refunds included. Live in minutes.

planTraditional.title: Traditional escrow
planTraditional.text: Bank-only, USD-centric, days of paperwork, and often unavailable in the CEMAC region at all.

faq.q: Is there a monthly fee?
faq.a: No. There is no subscription, no account fee and no minimum volume. You pay the escrow fee once, when a deal is funded, and nothing else.

faq.q: When exactly is the fee charged?
faq.a: At funding. The fee is calculated and shown before either party commits, added to what the buyer pays when the escrow is funded, and itemised on the PDF receipt.

faq.q: How is the FX rate set?
faq.a: We use the live mid-market rate at the moment of conversion and add a 1.2% margin. Both the rate and the margin appear on screen before you confirm, so the amount you see is the amount that moves.

faq.q: Do big deals get a different rate?
faq.a: No. The same rate applies to every deal, whatever its size, so the fee is always easy to check. Withdrawals of 500,000 XAF or more to mobile money get an extra manual review before payout, at no extra charge.

meta.title: About us - escrow built in Cameroon
meta.description: Bizik is an escrow service built in Cameroon by Lyftsoft Technologies, so people who have never met can buy, sell and hire online without either side taking the risk.

about.title: We're making every online deal in Africa safe.
about.text: Bizik is a Cameroonian company building the trust layer for African commerce - starting with escrow that runs on the money rails people actually use.
about.whyImgAlt: Local commerce in Cameroon - a seller with a phone
about.whyP1: One of our founders sold a laptop on Facebook Marketplace and spent three weeks arguing over who should send first. The other watched a cousin lose 400,000 XAF to a "seller" who disappeared the same afternoon.
about.whyP2: Every online deal here starts with the same standoff, and it costs real money and real opportunity. Escrow already solves it - but the existing services want a bank account, a Western currency and a week of paperwork.
about.whyP3: So we built escrow for a phone, in FCFA, in English and French, and made it work with MTN MoMo and Orange Money.
about.surfacesTitle: We meet people where they are
about.surfacesSub: The same escrow, the same account, on three surfaces - because trust shouldn't require downloading anything.

surfaces.title: WhatsApp Assistant
surfaces.text: Zero install. Chat or voice, EN/FR - create, fund, verify and release right in the conversation, with PIN-confirmed payments.

surfaces.title: Mobile app
surfaces.text: Full-featured on Android and iOS, offline-friendly, with push notifications for every deal event.

surfaces.title: Web
surfaces.text: An installable web app for deals, wallet and verification - nothing to download, works on any browser.

about.mission: Make it normal for two strangers in Africa to do business without either one taking the risk alone.
about.vision: A continent where trust is infrastructure - and every marketplace, freelancer and trader can plug into it.

meta.title: Security - how we protect your money
meta.description: Segregated escrow funds, verified identities, PIN-confirmed payments, manual review of large withdrawals and neutral dispute mediation. How Bizik keeps deal money safe.

security.title: How we protect your money and your data
security.text: Escrow only works if you believe the middle is solid. Here is exactly what sits in the middle: segregated funds, bank-grade encryption, verified identities and neutral mediation.

funds.title: Segregated escrow accounts
funds.text: Customer funds are held in dedicated escrow accounts with our licensed payment partners, separate from Bizik's operating money. They are never used to run the business.

funds.title: Release only on approval
funds.text: A release requires the buyer's approval, an expired inspection window, or a mediator's ruling. There is no fourth way for money to leave escrow.

funds.title: Manual review on large payouts
funds.text: Payouts above our threshold are reviewed by a human before they execute, and reconciled daily against the escrow ledger.

platform.title: Encryption everywhere
platform.text: TLS in transit, encryption at rest for personal and KYC data, isolated secrets management.

platform.title: KYC identity checks
platform.text: Government ID plus liveness for verified sellers and for any deal above the verification threshold.

platform.title: AML & sanctions screening
platform.text: Every party and payout is screened against sanctions and PEP lists, with monitoring for suspicious patterns.

platform.title: Fraud controls
platform.text: Velocity limits, device fingerprinting, and blocks on prohibited transactions and off-platform payment attempts.

platform.title: Your account
platform.text: SMS OTP login, session and device management, and alerts on every escrow, release and payout event.

platform.title: Neutral mediation
platform.text: Mediators are paid the same whatever they decide. We hold no stake in the outcome of your dispute.

security.vulnText: We welcome responsible disclosure and respond to every credible report within two working days. Please don't test against real user deals.

meta.title: Escrow for freelancers in Cameroon
meta.description: Get paid for every job: clients fund each milestone into escrow before you start, and the money is released when the work is approved. Withdraw to MTN MoMo or Orange Money.

freelancers.title: Get paid for every job you finish.
freelancers.text: The client funds the project up front, Bizik holds it, and the money reaches your Mobile Money the moment your work is approved. No invoices chased, no "next week" that never comes.
freelancers.imgAlt: A freelancer working at a laptop in Douala
freelancers.problemTitle: You already did the work. That's the worst time to start negotiating.
freelancers.problemText: A client you met online promises 50% up front and pays 20%. The deliverables go out. Then the messages slow down, the "accountant is travelling", and you’re one freelancer with no leverage against someone in another country.

steps.title: 1 · Client funds before you start
steps.text: You send a deal link. They pay into escrow. You can see the money is confirmed before you open a single file.

steps.title: 2 · Deliver milestone by milestone
steps.text: Split a long project into stages. Each stage is funded and released on its own, so you're never carrying months of unpaid work.

steps.title: 3 · Approved, then paid
steps.text: The client approves, or the inspection window expires and it auto-releases. Money lands on MTN, Orange, your bank or Payoneer.

benefits.title: Look professional
benefits.text: A funded escrow deal reads more seriously than an invoice PDF.

benefits.title: Work with anyone
benefits.text: Take clients in Paris, Lagos or Montreal without wondering if they'll pay.

benefits.title: Bill in their currency
benefits.text: Quote in EUR or USD, get paid out in FCFA at a rate you saw up front.

benefits.title: Scope protection
benefits.text: Revision requests are logged. Endless free rounds stop being invisible.

freelancers.quote: I stopped asking for deposits and started sending Bizik deals instead. Two clients said it made me look more serious. Nobody has argued about it since.

meta.title: Send money in Cameroon - free, instant wallet transfers
meta.description: Send money to anyone on Bizik with their @handle or phone number. Free, instant and confirmed by name before it leaves. Top up with MTN MoMo or Orange Money.

sendMoney.title: Send money in Cameroon, free and instantly
sendMoney.text: Pay a friend, a relative or a colleague from your Bizik wallet using their @handle or phone number. The money arrives in seconds, Bizik charges nothing for the transfer, and you see the recipient's name before you confirm.

facts.title: No transfer fee
facts.text: Bizik does not charge for sending money from one wallet to another, whatever the amount.

facts.title: Instant
facts.text: The recipient's balance updates the moment you confirm. Both of you are notified straight away.

facts.title: No wrong number
facts.text: You send to a @handle or a phone number, and Bizik shows you the account holder's name before anything moves.

facts.title: Protected by your PIN
facts.text: Only a verified account can send, and every transfer needs your confirmation. On WhatsApp it also needs your PIN.

steps.title: Top up your wallet
steps.text: Add money with MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money. Your balance updates as soon as your operator confirms the payment.

steps.title: Enter a @handle or phone number
steps.text: Type the recipient's Bizik handle, like @maxime.b, or their phone number. Bizik finds the account and shows the name.

steps.title: Confirm and it arrives
steps.text: Check the name and the amount, add a note if you like, and confirm. The money is in their wallet immediately.

sendMoney.detailTitle: Everything you need to know before you send

details.title: Who you can send to
details.text: Anyone with a Bizik account. If the person you want to pay is not on Bizik yet, they can create a free account in a few minutes with just their phone number, and you can send as soon as they have. Transfers go wallet to wallet, in your wallet's currency (XAF in Cameroon).

details.title: Top up with MTN MoMo or Orange Money
details.text: Your wallet is funded from the mobile money you already use. You approve the payment on your phone, and the balance is available to send as soon as the operator confirms it. Your operator may charge its own fees on its side.

details.title: Verify once, then send
details.text: To protect everyone, sending money needs a verified account. Verification is a one-time identity check done from the app. Receiving never needs it.

details.title: Send from the web, the app or WhatsApp
details.text: Use the Send button in your wallet on the web or in the app, or write to the Bizik assistant on WhatsApp, for example "send 5,000 to @maxime.b". WhatsApp always asks you to confirm and enter your PIN.

details.title: A receipt for every transfer
details.text: Every transfer appears in your wallet history, and you can download a PDF receipt for it. The recipient is told by notification, email and WhatsApp or SMS.

sendMoney.compareTitle: A direct transfer or a secure deal?
sendMoney.compareText: A transfer is final: once it arrives it cannot be reversed. That is exactly right for paying people you know. When you pay for goods or work you have not received yet, use a secure deal instead, so Bizik holds the money until you approve.

faq.q: How much does it cost to send money with Bizik?
faq.a: Nothing. Bizik does not charge a fee for sending money from your wallet to another Bizik wallet. Your mobile-money operator may charge its own fee when you top up your wallet.

faq.q: How long does a transfer take?
faq.a: It is instant. The money is in the recipient's wallet as soon as you confirm, and both of you are notified.

faq.q: Can I send money to someone who does not have Bizik?
faq.a: Not directly. The recipient needs a Bizik account, which is free and takes a few minutes to open with a phone number. Once they have one, you can send to their @handle or phone number.

faq.q: Can I cancel or reverse a transfer?
faq.a: No. A transfer is final once confirmed, which is why Bizik shows you the recipient's name first. If you are paying for something you have not received, use a secure deal so the money is only released when you approve.

faq.q: Can the person I pay withdraw to MTN MoMo or Orange Money?
faq.a: Yes. The money lands in their Bizik wallet, and once their account is verified they can withdraw it to a verified MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money number.

faq.q: Do I need to verify my identity to send money?
faq.a: Yes. Sending money needs a verified account. It is a one-time check done in the app. Receiving money does not need verification.

meta.title: Receive money in Cameroon - get paid with your Bizik handle
meta.description: Share one @handle and get paid into your Bizik wallet, instantly and for free. Cash out to MTN MoMo or Orange Money whenever you like.

receiveMoney.title: Receive money with one simple handle
receiveMoney.text: Give people your Bizik @handle instead of your phone number. Anyone on Bizik can pay you in seconds, for free, and you cash out to MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money whenever you like.

facts.title: Free to receive
facts.text: Bizik charges nothing when someone sends money to your wallet.

facts.title: Instant
facts.text: Money lands in your balance the moment the sender confirms, and you are notified right away.

facts.title: Keep your number private
facts.text: Share a @handle instead of your phone number. People can still find you by number if you give it to them.

facts.title: No verification to receive
facts.text: You can receive money as soon as you sign up. Verification is only needed when you withdraw or send.

steps.title: Create your free account
steps.text: Sign up with your phone number. Your Bizik handle is ready straight away, on the web, in the app and on WhatsApp.

steps.title: Share your @handle
steps.text: Copy it from your wallet and send it on WhatsApp, put it on your status or your business card. The sender sees your name before they confirm.

steps.title: Get paid, then cash out
steps.text: The money arrives instantly. Keep it in your wallet or withdraw it to your MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money number.

receiveMoney.detailTitle: From your wallet to your mobile money

details.title: Withdraw to MTN MoMo or Orange Money
details.text: Add your mobile-money number once and confirm it with a code sent by SMS. After that, withdrawals go to that number. A standard withdrawal has no Bizik fee; your operator may charge its own.

details.title: Large withdrawals are checked by a person
details.text: Withdrawals of 500,000 XAF or more to mobile money are reviewed by the Bizik team before they are paid out. It adds a little time and protects your money if your account is ever misused.

details.title: Verify once to withdraw
details.text: You can receive without verifying, but withdrawing needs a verified account. It is a one-time identity check done in the app, and it also lets you send money.

details.title: Hold more than one currency
details.text: Your wallet can hold XAF, USD, EUR, GBP, NGN and GHS. You can convert between them at the live mid-market rate plus a {{fxPct}}% margin, shown before you confirm.

details.title: Know exactly what came in
details.text: Every payment shows in your wallet history with the sender and their note, and you can download a PDF receipt. You are told by notification, email and WhatsApp or SMS.

receiveMoney.compareTitle: Getting paid by someone you do not know?
receiveMoney.compareText: A transfer is final and there is no protection if something goes wrong on either side. If you are selling goods or doing work for someone new, ask them to pay through a secure deal: the money is locked for you before you deliver, and released when they approve.

faq.q: How do I receive money on Bizik?
faq.a: Share your Bizik @handle, or the phone number on your account, with the person paying you. When they send, the money arrives in your wallet instantly and you are notified.

faq.q: Does it cost anything to receive money?
faq.a: No. Bizik does not charge you to receive a transfer. A standard withdrawal to mobile money has no Bizik fee either; your operator may charge its own.

faq.q: Do I need to verify my identity to receive money?
faq.a: No. You can receive as soon as you create an account. You need to verify your identity once before you can withdraw or send money.

faq.q: How do I withdraw to MTN MoMo or Orange Money?
faq.a: Add your mobile-money number in your wallet and confirm it with the code sent by SMS, then choose Withdraw. Withdrawals of 500,000 XAF or more are reviewed by a person before they are paid out.

faq.q: Can someone pay me without a Bizik account?
faq.a: They need a Bizik account to send you money. It is free and takes a few minutes with a phone number. They can top up their wallet with MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money and then pay your @handle.

faq.q: Can I request money or share a payment link?
faq.a: Not yet. Today you receive money by sharing your @handle. To be paid for goods or work by someone new, create a secure deal and invite them by phone number.

welcome.title: Welcome to Bizik, {{name}}
welcome.body: Bizik holds money safely while two people complete a deal. The buyer pays in, the money waits in escrow, and it is only released when the work is done - so neither side has to trust the other first.
welcome.done: Bizik holds money safely while two people complete a deal.

verify.title: Verify your identity
verify.body: A photo of your ID and a selfie. It is required before you can send money, withdraw, or start a deal - it is what keeps the person on the other side of a deal accountable.
verify.done: Your identity is verified. You can send, withdraw and start deals.

wallet.title: Your wallet
wallet.body: Add money from MTN or Orange Money, hold it, send it to another Bizik user for free, or withdraw it back to your phone. Money in your wallet is yours - it is separate from anything held in escrow.
wallet.done: Your wallet holds your money, separate from anything in escrow.

send.title: Send money to someone
send.body: Pay anyone on Bizik by their @handle or their phone number. It arrives instantly and costs nothing - we do not charge for sending between Bizik accounts. You need to be verified to send; you can receive without it. Your own handle is on your wallet screen, and that is what people use to pay you.
send.done: You can send money to any Bizik user by their @handle or phone number, free.

deal.title: Start a deal
deal.body: Agree what is being delivered and for how much, then invite the other person by phone number. The money is held until you confirm delivery. If something goes wrong, either side can open a dispute.
deal.done: You already know how deals work.

help.title: If you get stuck
help.body: Support is in the app, and you can also reach us on WhatsApp. If a deal goes wrong, open a dispute from the deal itself and a mediator will look at the evidence from both sides.
help.done: Support is in the app whenever you need it.

assistant.disclosure: AI assistant. It proposes, you approve.
